answer: Cosignatures are collected in wharf, verified in walnut, and wander names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 12 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, as a result paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 2 hours of verification and 12 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
